messages:
alex: Heads-up — proposal for a couple small deploy-bot flags and a release-note bootstrap. Trying to reduce finger-math during changewindows and make rollbacks less manual.

mira: TL;DR?

alex: Short list:
- checksum flag to assert artifact identity before rollout
- rescue-pin command that pins previous stable and aborts in-flight
- automatic release-note draft from release metadata + changelog snippets
- changewindow assert (fail outside approved window unless override)

jonah: Sounds good. Example cli?

alex: Example deploy-bot command (proposal):
```
/deploy service=payment-api model=v2.3.1 \  --pin=sha256:8f3a1b \  --checksum=sha256:8f3a1b \  --change-window="2026-04-01T22:00/2026-04-02T02:00" \  --canary=5% \  --on-failure="rescue-pin previous"
```

samir: checksum and pin duplication — maybe use --assert-artifact=sha256:8f3a1b and bot populates pin?

lina: +1 for auto release notes. We waste time copy/pasting PR descriptions.

alex: Release-note draft template proposal (bot emits PR body):
```
Release notes (auto-draft)
Service: payment-api
Version: v2.3.1
Artifact: sha256:8f3a1b
Change window: 2026-04-01 22:00 -> 2026-04-02 02:00
Canary: 5%
Summary:
- Payment gateway: reduce timeout for retry logic (PR #412)
- Metrics: add latency histogram (PR #415)
Rollout plan:
- Canary 5% for 10m, if errors < 0.5% -> 50% for 30m -> 100%
Rollback plan:
- On >=0.8% errors, run: /deploy rescue-pin service=payment-api reason=error-spike
Notes:
- Preflight: config check, migration no-op verified.
```

jonah: For rollback we need an idempotent rescue-pin flow: bot does
1) freeze new pins
2) pin last known-good commit
3) trigger immediate routing fallback
4) annotate incident

deploy-bot: [bot] preflight plugin suggestions: run artifact checksum, run schema-migrations dry-run, run smoke tests. Failed checks abort deploy.

mira: UX Q: how does change-window override work for emergencies?

alex: Proposal: `--override-change-window=team-oncall` requires `@oncall` ack in thread. Bot records ack and needs 2 approvals for prod bypass.

samir: Edge case: staggered services (db-migration windows) — add `--migration-safe` flag to force deploy to run migration-safety checks.

lina: Who owns the PR for this? I'll take release-note bot and template generator.

alex: I'll open infra PR for bot flags and rescue-pin orchestration. Drafting prototypes now, will post RFC link.

mira: Sounds good. Quick checklist:
- [ ] CLI flags: --assert-artifact, --rescue-pin, --change-window, --override-change-window
- [ ] Bot: generate release-note draft
- [ ] Bot: require approvals for override
- [ ] Rescue-pin idempotency + telemetry event
- [ ] Docs + playbook snippets

jonah: If you want reviewers: @mira @samir @lina

lina: added to my calendar to pair on tests.

alex: Will create two small PRs this week. Ping me here for quick reviews. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [bot] Created preflight checklist: /deploy preflight --service=payment-api -> preflight id pf_2026_0001

mira: acked. :thumbsup:
